kind: coding agent CLI and agent protocol

runtime.execution: Node provider/chat loop and event-driven Scheduler; CLI has traditional and config-gated AgentSession host paths; tool/service children include PTY processes.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns local session JSONL, tool registries, hooks and shell/background lifecycle; consumes Gemini content generators, MCP and A2A agents. Local child tools are scoped/cloned rather than independent fabric consumers.

summary: Gemini CLI implements hook-programmable requests/continuations, concurrent tool scheduling, cancellable shell/background handles and local/A2A delegation. Conversation JSONL and protocol replay provide partial originals/continuity but not complete audit or quiescent executable refit.

inspection.scope: Selected source excerpts trace exposed entry/loop/request/action/result/state boundaries and relevant capability mechanisms; listed tests are read as source only.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed, dependencies installed or live providers invoked. Claims concern this pinned snapshot; untraced catalog tools and dependency internals are not inferred.

actions.name: read_file
actions.output: processed text/media or typed path/read error
actions.authority: model; workspace access validation and policy

actions.name: write_file / replace
actions.lifecycle: write path lock and abort checked; replace catalog/name traced, internals untraced

actions.name: run_shell_command
actions.lifecycle: shared signal reaches shell; promotion moves existing process to service ownership; PTY abort escalates group kill

actions.name: list_background_processes / read_background_output
actions.input: empty list request or pid/delay/output limits
actions.output: session PID/status/exit list or bounded log tail
actions.lifecycle: polls owned background job; delay path ignores abort; log may be removed

actions.name: invoke_agent
actions.lifecycle: local/remote/browser routing; feature-gated session mode propagates abort; local nested agents excluded
actions.authority: model/configured agent registry and derived confirmation bus

actions.name: RemoteSubagentSession.send / getSessionState / abort
actions.lifecycle: one active send, reusable process-map A2A conversation state; updates/actions unused
actions.authority: harness/remote service authentication, not native peer messaging tool

actions.name: HookSystem.registerHook / setHookEnabled
actions.lifecycle: synchronous loop boundaries; runtime timeout cooperative; installed command plumbing separately supplied
actions.authority: host/operator or code extension; no native model registration tool established

actions.name: tryCompressChat / ChatCompressionService.compress
actions.output: verified state snapshot + retained tail or truncation/failure status
actions.lifecycle: summary and verification requests; active history replaced while recorder retained
actions.authority: harness/operator; self-correction summary prompt is not post hoc native repair

actions.name: AgentSession.stream
actions.lifecycle: subscribe before replay; reject invalid or not-yet-started cursor; in-memory protocol state

actions.name: AgentsRefreshed → setTools/updateSystemInstruction
actions.lifecycle: immediate active-client refresh; no affected-workflow deferred fence traced

actions.name: /bug
actions.output: chat-history file + prefilled GitHub issue URL
actions.lifecycle: exports then opens browser; does not itself file issue
actions.authority: operator; no model grievance action or external table

filesystem.detail: Workspace-validated native reads/writes, same-path write locking, typed results and native replacement catalog.

processes.detail: Shell propagates combined abort, streams output, background promotion returns PID and polls session logs; PTY cancellation escalates process-group kill.

code_actions.detail: File replacement/write, Bash-like shell and configurable agent/MCP tools supply code operations; no independently shared compiler/kernel contract established.

persistent_kernel.detail: Persistent interpreter namespace not established in inspected shell/service/agent loop paths.

standing_database.detail: Task tracker/tool catalog and conversation JSONL are not a shared queryable computation/database contract in inspected paths.

workflow_programming.detail: Actual before/after agent/model/tool and tool-selection hook wiring can inject/rewrite/filter/block/retry. Runtime action API is programmable; cooperative cancellation limit matters.

multi_model.detail: Per-request model config/hook model rewrite and definition-driven local/remote agents expose real model routing, without implying shared-peer dialogue.

live_collaboration.detail: Delegated local/A2A work has streamed observability and reusable context/task handles, but remote protocol rejects active-stream send and ignores update/action/elicitations; local child excludes nested agent tools.

concurrent_work.detail: Scheduler runs contiguous parallelizable tool groups; edit/write/topic serialize and wait_for_previous gives model ordering control. Child registry isolates cloned tool state.

steering_interrupt.detail: Signal crosses provider/turn/scheduler/native shell and remote session; tool events carry cancellation. Remote active-message steering is limited; delayed background-log read ignores signal.

turn_redefinition.detail: Hooks rewrite request model/config/contents/tools and AfterAgent controls halt/retry/context clear with bounded recursive continuation. Turn orchestration remains fixed host implementation.

compaction.detail: Separate summary plus model verification requests use original inputs when fitting; new active history preserves recording object/file and distinguishes content truncation.

context_repair.detail: Compaction verifier can correct its own summary before activation and originals remain in recorder path; no native model original-fetch/restore protocol established. Model critique is not independent correctness oracle.

original_audit.detail: Append-only same-ID conversation versions and retained recorder across compression preserve selected conversation originals. ENOSPC disables writes, foreground temp artifacts are cleaned, and full transport/effect audit is not established.

audit_query.detail: Conversation JSONL materialization plus event-cursor replay and background log polling are usable primitives. In-memory protocol events are not a complete durable global audit/query API.

hot_change.detail: Runtime hook registration/toggle and agent refresh update active client definitions immediately. No deferred affected-workflow activation or compilation handoff traced.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Protocol event replay and reusable remote IDs support reconnect composition but rely on object/static state; do not establish quiescent executable refit or uncertain-effect continuity.

remote_services.detail: Consumes Gemini content generator, configured MCP catalog and authenticated A2A remote agents; shell/service state still owned by local harness.

self_improvement.detail: Programmable hooks and file/process actions do not demonstrate model-governed measured improvement or self-recompile/reinhabit protocol.

complaints.detail: Operator /bug packages active chat plus issue URL/browser opening; no native model complaint carrying full agent state into independently tracked table.

authority.detail: Scheduler confirmation context, derived child bus/cloned registry, workspace path validation and shell sandbox options are traced. Operator-free configurations are possible only within configured policy; policy internals not exhaustively audited.

evaluation.detail: Read source tests cover runtime hook registration/input, hook-stop nonexecution and Unicode-safe history collapse. Mocks/pure transforms do not prove live summary adequacy or OS cancellation convergence; not executed.

time_order.detail: UUID conversation IDs/timestamps, call IDs and protocol cursor/stream lifecycle support ordering; no cross-service durable causal clock or exactly-once effect log established.

evidence.claim: Noninteractive host chooses ADK/AgentSession branch via configuration; traditional loop remains separately wired.
Traditional CLI sends current parts through GeminiClient with common abort signal and bounded turn counter.
Native calls schedule with same abort signal; structured streaming results carry timestamp/call ID/status.
Session loop sends provider work, collects calls, handles errors/abort, nudges empty post-tool answers, schedules operations and emits paired results.
BeforeAgent injects/blocks/stops; AfterAgent can clear context, halt or recursively request bounded continuation with hook state reset.
Turn calls GeminiChat with model config, request/history override and signal; transforms retries/cancellation/hook responses into events.
BeforeModel modifies model/config/contents, can synthesize blocked response, and BeforeToolSelection modifies tools before actual content generator stream.
Contiguous parallelizable requests validate and execute together; edit/write/topic serialize and wait_for_previous overrides; terminal calls finalize.
Executor passes signal, shell config, PID callback and live output through hook-wrapped tool invocation; abort results become cancellation.
Config registers native file/search/shell/background/web/MCP/skill/plan/task/agent tools with configuration-dependent availability.
Native file/process names are read_file, run_shell_command, write_file and replace.
Read validates real workspace path and returns processed file content/range or typed error.
Write validates path and serializes same-path writers with cancellable lock before apply.
Write creates directories, normalizes line endings, writes through filesystem service and produces diff.
Shell streams text/binary events, uses combined controller and sandbox/session execution options.
Background timer promotes existing PID and returns initial output after race; foreground awaits result.
Background ownership transfers temp directory to execution service; foreground finally removes temp artifacts and abort listeners.
PTY abort invokes escalating process-group kill and returns process identity/result handle.
list_background_processes enumerates current-session command PID/status/exit metadata.
read_background_output checks PID session ownership and reads bounded log tail with O_NOFOLLOW; delay ignores abort in this path.
invoke_agent schema resolves agent_name and comprehensive prompt into registry-specific inputs.
Delegate selects browser/local/remote and feature-gated session invocation, propagates signal and live output through actual invocation.
Local child clones tools into isolated registry and derived confirmation bus; nested agent tools and update_topic are excluded.
Remote protocol exposes events and context/task state; rejects message send while stream active and ignores update/action/elicitations.
A2A stream consumes context/task IDs, updates them from responses and emits streamed deltas/progress.
Session invocation seeds prior A2A state, wires parent abort, observes progress and detects empty-result abort.
A2A context/task state is retained in process-static invocation map even on abort/error, not a durable executable handoff.
Compression prefers original history when it fits and makes separate initial summary plus model verification/self-correction requests.
Compression creates a new active chat while carrying recording conversation/file; truncation updates current history without resetting failure flag.
Normal record append is JSONL; ENOSPC disables persistence and unreadable-file recovery attempts backup then atomic rewrite.
Full same-ID updates append to log but latest overwrite in-memory materialization; messages get durable UUID/time and selected thoughts/tokens.
Synthetic messages, thought summaries/tokens and enriched tool calls are recorded; not all provider transport/OS effects.
Wrapper replays event cursor/stream boundaries and listens for new events; unknown/pre-agent-start resume cursors reject. Protocol event history is object state.
Host hook API supports enable/disable and runtime registration by event/matcher/sequencing.
Runtime hook action runs against timeout race and cooperative abort controller; timeout/error requests abort, not forcibly terminating JS action.
Agent refresh event immediately updates active client tools/system if initialized.
Operator /bug exports active chat history and opens prefilled GitHub URL; no native model complaint/database submission traced.
Runtime hook test asserts registration/callback input/finalOutput using mock action.
Hook stop test asserts error and nonexecution of mocked tool.
Pure collapse test checks emoji/surrogate/UTF-8 integrity and recent output preservation; not semantic adequacy of model summary.

tests.focus: Runtime registration and event action input
tests.oracle: Uses mocked action and asserts registry source/input/output; no uncooperative timeout or full turn integration oracle.
Asserts error and mocked executor never invoked; not OS side-effect audit.
Pure fabricated history asserts no replacement/unpaired characters and UTF-8 roundtrip; not semantic state-snapshot quality.

strengths: Hooks alter actual request/continuation lifecycle rather than only appending prompts.
Model wait_for_previous plus serial edit/topic classes make tool-order authority explicit.
Append-only message versions and recorder retained through compaction are stronger than overwriting a transcript.
A2A context/task handles persist across same-process delegated invocations and aborts; actual remote consumer protocol.
limits: Traditional CLI and feature-gated AgentSession scopes remain distinct; source replay does not establish default host use everywhere.
Remote protocol is sequential delegation, rejects sends while active and ignores update/action/elicitations; local nested delegation excluded.
Self-verifying summaries have no independent semantic-loss oracle.
Audit is selected conversation data; ENOSPC disables persistence, temp/output cleanup and external effects bound originals.
Runtime hook timeout only requests cooperative abort; active definitions can refresh immediately; no refit quiescence/standing-pause contract.
arconaut_questions: How can Arconaut expose programmable request/settlement boundaries with model authority while preserving scoped services and explicit activation versions?
Retain immutable provider/tool/context originals and attach projection versions; let models inspect and repair without relying only on summary self-critique.
Generalize remote context/task IDs into an outpost consumer protocol with live messaging and durable checkpoint—not a process-static map.
What verified quiescence barrier distinguishes cancellable requests from arbitrary hooks or standing/background owned computation?
